bio: The traditional Parkhotel Adler, which has been a family-run business for over 500 years, is home to this historical Black Forest establishment whose origins date back to 1639. It has five really pleasant dining areas, from the charming Stube with its old wood panelling and a low ceiling, to the chic Bergkristall, and of course the terrace. The cuisine comprises Baden and international dishes; vegetarian options are also available. The wine list features a good selection of wines from the region. For an overnight stay, there are cosy, elegant guestrooms....
